title: Anna's Shopping List
text:
Anna is going to the supermarket today. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, eggs, bread, and apples. She needs these things for breakfast.

At the supermarket, Anna finds the milk first. Then she takes the bread and some apples. She forgets the eggs at first, but she sees them near the end and buys them too.

questions.text: What is on Anna's shopping list?
What does Anna forget at first?
Why does Anna make a shopping list?
options: So she does not forget the things she needs
Because she wants to sell food
Because she is going to school

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's breakfast?
options: She will eat eggs and bread

vocabulary.definition: a large shop that sells food and other goods
a set of written words or items
the first meal of the day

paragraph_translations: Anna bugün süpermarkete gidiyor. Elinde bir alışveriş listesi var. Listede süt, yumurta, ekmek ve elma var. Bu şeyleri kahvaltı için almaya ihtiyacı var.
Süpermarkette Anna önce sütü buluyor. Sonra ekmeği ve birkaç elma alıyor. Yumurtayı ilk başta unutur, ama sonunda onları görür ve onları da satın alır.
